verdict.rationale: JumpCloud confirms a REST API (v2.0 spec at docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml) with GET endpoints for traversing users/groups/bindings, plus GitHub scripts showing API usage and bulk operations across users/devices/groups. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of pagination, filtering syntax, or auth mechanisms, and probes for openapi/llms.txt discovery paths returned 404s, suggesting weaker machine-readable API discoverability than claimed. Missing for 10: explicit pagination/filtering documentation, clear auth flow details, and successful automated API-spec discovery.
